g.text: MASKED PPO SELF-PLAY · PFSP LEAGUE · SCENARIO CURRICULUM
What one decision runs through at play time, and the critic that exists only in training
PLAY TIME · one decision, left to right
hand, battlefield, graveyard, exile, stack, library
life, lands, mana, turn, step, what is pending
expected cards in the opponent's hand, piles and
targets on the stack · pure arithmetic, no parameters
every card slot the same way,
which actions are legal right now
width = how many slots each kind has
hatched = the two 'cancel' actions, never allowed (they taught stalling)
about 1 ms per decision on one CPU core · a fifth of decisions have one legal action and skip the network
TRAINING ONLY · never runs at play time
both players' hands, nothing of the
used only to weight the policy's updates:
no learned belief net, no attention,
